anyOf.description: Empty object kept when the command fails before assigning data.

auth.description: none: no security declared; bearer: HAIVEN_TOKEN attached; missing: required but HAIVEN_TOKEN is unset.

content_type.description: The request body's media type, when there is one.

body.description: The response body when it is JSON.

body_text.description: The response body when it is not JSON, or was cut at the bound.

error_code.description: The API's own error code (the body's code or error field) on an error status.

redacted.description: Token, secret and password fields replaced with [redacted]; --show-secrets keeps them.

response.description: Absent on --dry-run and when the API could not be reached.

title: haiven api call data
description: Command payload, or an empty object when the command fails before it assigns data. An empty object is not a successful payload.
